answer: Make standing flow only through randomly assigned counterparts. Each epoch a public beacon pairs every agent with one peer, and trust is earned only from that pairing, like water entering a field through a single inlet instead of any ditch you dig. A sybil ring can no longer vine its members together by attesting each other, because it rarely meets itself. Any pair whose signal of mutual praise beats its random baseline is down-weighted, so each fake identity must earn trust from strangers at full cost.
